newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-CRONJE WANTS MORE DISCIPLINE FROM BATSMEN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CRONJE WANTS MORE DISCIPLINE FROM BATSMEN.

text.p: South African captain Hansie Cronje has called for greater discipline from his batsmen in the second test against India starting on Wednesday.
"We are concerned about our batting and have identified our problem areas," Cronje said before a practice session on Tuesday.
"I think our batsmen have to be a little more disciplined in the selection of their shots. There can be no excuse for not having achieved a 170-run target, whatever the conditions."
South Africa, set 170 to win in the first test in Ahmedabad, were dismissed for only 105.
To add to the visitors' misery, middle-order batsman Jonty Rhodes, one of the world's finest fielders, has been ruled out after pulling a left hamstring in the first test.
Rhodes' place might be filled by Herschelle Gibbs, a stylish middle-order batsman and a fine fielder.
South Africa's main strike bowler, Allan Donald is another doubtful starter after sustaining an ankle injury.
If he is unable to play, Lance Klusener, a medium-pace bowler and middle-order batsman may make his test debut.
The Indians also face selection problems, athough in their case, it may be an embarassment of riches.

With hometown hero, batsman Saurav Ganguly have fully recovered from the injury which made him miss two one-day games and the first test, the team management will have to decide who to drop to accommodate him.
If India decide on a defensive approach and play only four specialist bowlers, either paceman Venkatesh Prasad or leg- spinner Narendra Hirwani may make way for Ganguly.
But this will hardly be in keeping with the aggressive strategy Sachin Tendulkar has adopted since taking over India's captaincy.
The Eden Gardens pitch is firm and should suit the batsmen.

India - Sanjay Manjrekar, Nayan Mongia, Saurav Ganguly, Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Mohammed Azharuddin, Rahul Dravid, V.V.S. Laxman, Javagal Srinath, Anil Kumble, Sunil Joshi, Venkatesh Prasad, Narendra Hirwani.

South Africa - Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Darryl Cullinan, Hansie Cronje (captain), Herschelle Gibbs, Brian McMillan, Dave Richardson, Fanie de Villiers, Lance Klusener, Allan Donald, Pat Symcox, Paul Adams.
